Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for different LLM configurations. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 150000, with tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The first line, colored gray, is labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)” and is a solid line. It begins at approximately 3.0 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.55 at an iteration of 150000. The second line, colored orange, is labeled “SepLLM (n=64)” and is a solid line. It begins at approximately 3.0 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.52 at an iteration of 150000. The third line, colored green, is labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)” and is a solid line. It begins at approximately 2.95 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.5 at an iteration of 150000. The fourth line, colored red, is labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” and is a solid line. It begins at approximately 2.9 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.48 at an iteration of 150000. The fifth line, colored purple, is labeled “SepLLM (n=128)” and is a solid line. It begins at approximately 3.1 at an iteration of 0 and decreases to approximately 2.58 at an iteration of 150000.
